name: md-to-docx-studio
description: A local-first Markdown to Word document studio with reusable templates.
author: Mohtasham Murshid

scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; copyFileSync('electron/preload.cjs', 'dist-electron/preload.cjs')"
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:electron
